summary: In University, Columbia, West Seattle, Queen Anne, and Fremont library branches, Seattle, Washington, Seattle Cool and Clean Air Library Upgrades is a planning and design initiative. The documented approach is to upgrade five library branches with air conditioning, modern ventilation, and related electrical/mechanical work to serve as cooling centers. The case addresses extreme heat and wildfire smoke. Available materials report five-branch project and branch-level design/bid/renovation statuses documented in 2025–2026 public materials. The available materials do not identify a measured health or resilience outcome.
